@graph.name: Micro design system reference
@graph.headline: Micro design system | Refero Styles
@graph.description: Explore Micro's light Productivity design system: Ink Black #221f1c, Paper White #f5f5f5 colors, perfectlyNineties, haffer typography, and DESIGN.md for AI...

gradients.value: linear-gradient(to right in oklab, rgb(81, 139, 219) 0%, rgb(54, 186, 184) 100%)

dos: Use the blue→teal gradient only on the hero; it is the single saturated viewport in the system and defines the brand opening
Set hero and section display headlines in perfectlyNineties at 30-72px with 0.02em positive tracking — the open tracking is the signature
Set body and product UI in haffer, not in the display face — the contrast between editorial and neutral is the typographic identity
Use 8px radius for buttons, inputs, and nav; 14px for product rows; 18px for feature blocks and graph nodes — do not mix freely
Keep product surfaces #ffffff with a 1px border and the subtle two-layer shadow — never heavy elevation
Reach for the pastel washes (#cbfbf1, #f8ebd8, #ede9fe, #cff2ef) for marketing feature blocks; let the canvas stay #f5f5f5
Color icons categorically with Teal Pulse, Coral Marker, Amber Marker, Orchid Marker, and Azure Action — never monochrome the icon set
donts: Do not apply the gradient sky to anything other than the top of the page — repeating it kills the opening impact
Do not use perfectlyNineties for body text, buttons, nav, or product UI — it is a display face only and will crush at small sizes
Do not skip the 1px border on product cards — the system relies on hairline edges, not shadows, to define surfaces
Do not use 4px radius on feature cards or marketing blocks — 4px is reserved for small chrome and icons, the card hierarchy starts at 8px
Do not introduce new chromatic accents beyond the named marker palette — the multicolor icon system is closed
Do not center body copy in the product UI — left-align data; the only centered text is the hero headline and section H1s
Do not use pure black #000000 for text — use #221f1c Ink Black; the warm undertone is part of the paper-on-ink feel

designSystem.imagery: Imagery is sparse and product-led: no lifestyle photography, no stock imagery. The hero is a full-bleed gradient sky over a green field, with a single floating product mockup that overlaps the horizon line — the product is the hero. Subsequent sections rely on large product UI screenshots (inbox, context graph) presented as floating cards with subtle shadows. The context graph is the most distinctive visual: a constellation of white data nodes connected by hairline lines, each node ringed in a different marker color, creating a network-as-illustration effect. Icons are multicolor line-and-fill marks in the brand palette. A small audio player widget (album art + transport) sits in the bottom-right corner as a persistent, almost decorative UI element. No 3D, no illustration system — the visual richness comes from data visualization and product UI itself.

similar.why: Same warm off-white canvas with near-black ink text, product-led hero with a single bold headline, and a similar reliance on subtle 1px borders rather than heavy shadows
Compact product UI density, dark filled primary buttons on light backgrounds, and a multicolor accent system used categorically across icons and tags
Bold gradient hero paired with a quieter product surface below, and a willingness to use a distinctive display typeface (not just another geometric sans) for brand personality
Pastel-tinted feature blocks floating on a neutral canvas, with the product UI itself doing the visual heavy lifting rather than illustration or photography

components.name: Dark Filled Button
components.role: Primary action button on light backgrounds (Sign up, Get started)
components.description: Background #221f1c (Ink Black), text #ffffff, radius 8px, padding 10px 16px, haffer 500 at 14px, 1.4 line-height. Optional inset 0 -2px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2) for pressed state. Inverts to white-on-dark when used on the gradient hero.

components.name: White Filled Button
components.role: Secondary action on the gradient hero (Talk to sales)
components.description: Background #ffffff, text #221f1c, radius 8px, padding 10px 16px, haffer 500 at 14px. No border, no shadow — relies on the gradient backdrop for contrast.

components.name: Ghost Text Button
components.role: Tertiary / nav action (Log in, Learn more)
components.description: Transparent background, text #221f1c (or #ffffff on dark), radius 8px, padding 8px 12px, haffer 500 at 14px. No visible border; relies on hover state to reveal affordance.

components.name: Pill Nav Tab
components.role: Top-bar navigation items (Product, Resources, Pricing, Careers)
components.description: Transparent background, text #221f1c haffer 500 14px, trailing 6px chevron icon in #797267, padding 6px 12px, radius 8px. Active state: #f5f5f5 fill. Lighter and more compact than buttons — nav reads as a row of whispers, not shouts.

components.name: Product Card (App UI)
components.role: Inbox row, task row, person/company record inside the product
components.description: Background #ffffff, border 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.065), radius 14px, padding 12px 16px, haffer 400 at 14px for primary text and #797267 for secondary timestamps. Left-side avatar/initial in a 32px circle, optional unread dot in #518bdb.

components.name: Context Graph Node
components.role: Floating data card in the 'personal context graph' visualization
components.description: Background #ffffff, radius 18px, padding 16px, haffer 500-700 at 12-14px, a 2-3px accent border in one of the marker colors (Teal Pulse, Coral Marker, Orchid Marker, Azure Action). Connected by thin 1px lines in #797267 at 0.4 opacity. The accent border color is the categorical signal — same data shape, different domain.

components.name: Soft Pastel Feature Block
components.role: Marketing feature card with tinted background
components.description: Background one of the pastel washes (#cbfbf1, #f8ebd8, #ede9fe, #cff2ef), radius 18px, padding 32px, no border, no shadow. Headline in haffer 600 at 20-24px in #221f1c, supporting body in haffer 400 at 14px in #797267. The pastel fill IS the visual interest — no icons or illustrations needed inside.

components.name: Search / Prompt Input
components.role: AI ask-bar at top of the product ('Ask Micro AI anything...') and search fields
components.description: Background #ffffff, border 1px solid #27272a at low opacity, radius 8px, padding 10px 14px, haffer 400 at 14px, placeholder in #8c8a88. Focus state: 2px ring in #518bdb. Left-side icon (search or sparkle) in #797267, optional right-side mic icon.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.role: Left-rail navigation inside the product (Home, Inbox, People, Companies, Tasks)
components.description: Transparent background, 20px row height, 12px horizontal padding, radius 8px, 14px haffer 400 in #221f1c. Active state: #f5f5f5 fill, haffer 500 weight. Leading 16px icon in #797267 (active: #221f1c). Generous vertical breathing room — sidebar is quiet chrome, not a feature wall.

components.name: Badge / Tag
components.role: Category tags, status pills (Important, VIPs, All DMs)
components.description: Background transparent or #f5f5f5, text #221f1c, radius 9999px, padding 4px 10px, haffer 500 at 12px. For colored status: background in marker color at 0.15 opacity, text in the same marker color at full opacity. No border.

components.name: Logo Strip
components.description: Single horizontal row, 5-6 monochrome logos in #221f1c, evenly spaced with 48-64px gap. Each logo is a simple geometric mark + wordmark at 18-20px haffer 600. No background card — logos float on the canvas.

components.name: Floating Audio Player
components.role: Bottom-right media player widget (New Computer track card)
components.description: Background #ffffff, radius 14px, shadow 0px 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), padding 8px 12px, 280-320px wide. 40px album art on left, track title in haffer 600 12px #221f1c, artist in haffer 400 10px #797267, transport controls on the right in #797267 with one accent (play) in #221f1c.

components.name: Hero Product Mockup Container
components.role: The floating app screenshot that overlaps the gradient sky and the green field below the fold
components.description: No visible card chrome — the screenshot is presented edge-to-edge with a subtle 0px 10px 15px shadow, 18px corner radius, and a 1px #1a3a12 (Forest Edge) border that gives it a framed-on-the-meadow feel. The border color is the signature: it ties the product UI to the green ground beneath it.

components.name: Section Eyebrow Pill
components.role: Small label above headlines (e.g., 'Watch the launch video')
components.description: Background #ffffff at 0.9 opacity, radius 9999px, padding 4px 12px, haffer 500 at 12px in #221f1c, optional leading icon at 12px. Floats above the headline with 16px gap.

typography.role: Display and editorial headlines (hero, section H1/H2, large marketing statements) — a chunky 70s/80s display face that gives the page magazine-cover weight. The 0.02em positive tracking at large sizes is a deliberate anti-trend: most modern display faces go tight, this one breathes open.
typography.substitute: Druk Wide, Climate Crisis, Recoleta, or a heavy condensed serif like Playfair Display 900

typography.role: Primary workhorse for body, UI labels, buttons, nav, product chrome, card content, and the 96px hero brand mark. The tight -0.025em tracking at 24px+ creates compact, confident headings; the 0.10em tracking on 8-10px eyebrow/uppercase labels adds editorial rhythm.
typography.substitute: Inter, Söhne, General Sans, or Geist Sans
typography.letterSpacing: -0.0250em at display sizes; 0.10em at micro/eyebrow sizes

typography.role: Monospace for timestamps, email addresses, technical metadata in inbox rows, and AI prompt placeholder text. The system-stack choice signals these are data, not prose.
typography.substitute: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, or any system monospace

rules.description: Color icons categorically with Teal Pulse, Coral Marker, Amber Marker, Orchid Marker, and Azure Action — never monochrome the icon set

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not apply the gradient sky to anything other than the top of the page — repeating it kills the opening impact

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not use perfectlyNineties for body text, buttons, nav, or product UI — it is a display face only and will crush at small sizes

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not skip the 1px border on product cards — the system relies on hairline edges, not shadows, to define surfaces

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not use 4px radius on feature cards or marketing blocks — 4px is reserved for small chrome and icons, the card hierarchy starts at 8px

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not introduce new chromatic accents beyond the named marker palette — the multicolor icon system is closed

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not center body copy in the product UI — left-align data; the only centered text is the hero headline and section H1s

rules.name: Don't
rules.description: Do not use pure black #000000 for text — use #221f1c Ink Black; the warm undertone is part of the paper-on-ink feel
